name: 48371 · Oxford, MI
findings: ZIP 48371 (Oxford) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48371 (Oxford) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48371 (Oxford) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
